Unos jóvenes investigan la desaparición de la hermana de uno de ellos, de quien se perdió el rastro en 1994 en un bosque vinculado a la leyenda de la bruja de Blair. Al llegar al lugar, conocen a un grupo de personas que se ofrecen a guiarlos.

Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

A family embarks on a perilous journey as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.
In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home.

Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of paranoia, surviving off-grid with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her while battling the consequences of his past.

Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool must protect a teenage mutant from Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other mutants to battle Cable and his powerful advanced weaponry.

A woman takes her two children on a weekend getaway to her late father's secluded, high-tech estate in the countryside. She soon finds herself in a desperate fight to save all of their lives when four men break into the house to find hidden money.

Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

On the run from a French animal-control officer (Frances McDormand), Alex (Ben Stiller) and friends (Chris Rock, David Schwimmer) hide out in a traveling circus, where they perform death-defying tricks and make some new friends.
Disowned by his obscenely wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

In 1823, fur trapper Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) treks through the snowy wilderness to track down John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy), a member of his hunting team who killed his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and left him for dead.

Liz lo arriesga todo para llenar su bote con caimanes. Ronnie y Ashley desafían el clima. Zak enfrenta a los elementos y se embarca solo por primera vez.

Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.
A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert.

Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.
An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate).
The hottest bartender (Tom Cruise) in Manhattan leaves his partner (Bryan Brown), goes to Jamaica and falls for a nice girl (Elisabeth Shue).

On the last night of 1999, two high school juniors crash a New Year's Eve party, only to find themselves fighting for their lives when the terror of Y2K becomes a reality and all machines rise up against humanity.
A struggling novelist (Paul Dano) creates an inspirational female character, who somehow leaps from the page into his home as a real flesh-and-blood woman (Zoe Kazan).
A woman (Jennifer Aniston) inseminates herself without knowing that her best friend (Jason Bateman) substituted her preferred sperm sample for his own.

Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

Bestowed with the almighty powers of the gods, Black Adam's unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone.

Kicked out by his parents, a gay teenager (Jeremy Irvine) leaves small-town Indiana for New York's Greenwich Village, where growing discrimination against the LGBT community leads to riots on June 28, 1969.

Dulcich and Freiburger enlist Chris Birdsong to finish the engine transplant into the 1974 Dodge D100 known as the Mopar Muscle Truck; after installing the Gen III Hemi, they hit the dyno to see the massive horsepower and torque the truck now makes.

Mike tracks down one of the most iconic estate cars of all time, the Volvo 240 Torslanda, but the car has seen better days; Elvis needs to get deep under the bonnet, and get super-creative with metal to bring it back to life.
With the Ford Focus hitting its 25th anniversary, Mike thinks the ST model could be the next classic; he finds one for under £3k, but Elvis discovers the engine needs a full rebuild.
Mike and Elvis are hoping to fix up a 1989 Audi Coupe before testing it out on a coast-to-coast route in Cornwall.

When Mike finds a 1992 Corrado G60 smothered in aftermarket mods, he wonders if they can make a profit by returning it to standard; parts are rare and unmaintained superchargers can prove costly; Elvis is determined to get this risky project done.
Chip gets the chance to become a real superhero when he comes to the rescue of a comic-book artist who has spent years trying to raise his Pontiac Firebird from the ashes.
The team works its magic on a neglected 1963 Cadillac El Dorado belonging to a Los Angeles police officer.
A musician becomes upset after he is accused of setting fire to his Thunderbird for insurance money, but he sings a different tune after he learns his vehicle is heading to the Overhaulin' shop.
Chip and the A-Team work on a 1970 Plymouth Barracuda that a nurse bought from her grandmother nearly 25 years earlier.

While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.
Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.
With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

Un programa de concurso picante, ligero y excitante el cual busca formar una o varias parejas entre los participantes que se gusten y se sientan atraídos.
Los participantes encarnan sus versiones de la década del 20 y bailan al ritmo de esta variedad de foxtrot.
Lupita y Bryan tienen una estrategia clara para vencer una exigente prueba: trapitos al sol. Edson y Erick se apresuran a capturar mariposas dentro de la jaula para lograr el escape perfecto.
David le da indicaciones a su amiga Mafer para superar un divertido reto, además, sin quemar ningún comodín, ellos avanzan con rapidez para llevarse hasta el premio mayor: un automóvil.
Rebeca alardea de hacer cosas malas para ser cool y su madre la puso en evidencia. Urbano le alquila un local a una congregación religiosa, pero su esposa comienza a formar parte y sale embarazada.
Raúl golpeó a su esposa porque Miladis salió embarazada y él es estéril. Por otro lado, por culpa de Javier, la esposa de Enrique fue deportada y ahora él está solo con sus hijos.
Rita acusa a Juana, su madre, de convertirse en la aliada de su nieta para obtener permisos y quitarle autoridad sobre su hija, quien rechaza la relación con Roberto, su nuevo esposo.
Fabián regresa a México después de ser deportado de los Estados Unidos. Se encuentra con su novia Ramona y descubre que ella tiene un prometido. El joven no se dará por vencido a perderla.
Rodrigo y su novia Adela se mudan a la capital para que él realice su sueño de ser un artista. La pareja deberá enfrentar nuevas tentaciones que la vida les pondrá en su camino.
Marina, con apenas ocho años, termina en manos de una pareja de explotadores de niños al escapar del abuso y maltrato de su propia familia. La intervención de una reportera cambia las cosas.
Mariana está desesperada y quiere huir de México cuanto antes. Ella sabe que su hermano y su hija están en peligro. Mano Negra tiene sed de venganza.
Yolanda aparenta ser fría e indolente, pero su diario esconde la desgarradora experiencia que vivió al ser abusada sexualmente. Su amigo Saúl, al descubrir su secreto, la ayuda a recuperarse.
Fabián debe enfrentarse a sus actos, aunque sean consecuencia de otros, y recorrer una ruta sin perder el control de su vida. Su objetivo es ganar tiempo y asegurar el bienestar de quienes ama.
Rubén cuestiona a su hija Luna por su relación amorosa y decide usar todas las herramientas para vigilarla, incluida una polémica solicitud a su jefe que provoca serias consecuencias.
Erick separa a Guadalupe de la hija que tienen juntos y la deja en otra ciudad con su abuelo. Asegura que ella es una irresponsable tras descubrir su infidelidad con uno de sus amigos.

Una nuova striscia informativa per raccontare l'Italia e il mondo giorno per giorno. Assistiamo a interviste a personaggi della politica interna e internazionale, del mondo artistico, culturale e dello spettacolo, tra temi sociali ed economici.
Fatti, vicende, libri, film e mostre che raccontano i cambiamenti dell'Italia contemporanea. Tra interviste, dibattiti, recensioni e stroncature, è possibile osservare uno spaccato del paese.

La nostra società vista attraverso gli occhi di ragazzi e ragazze, chiamati a partecipare ed essere protagonisti del dibattito. Cronaca, politica, attualità, partendo dal fatto del giorno.

I due presentatori ci raccontano con allegria, e in lingua inglese, i fatti principali che avvengono in Italia. Le notizie vengono presentate con un taglio accessibile anche a chi conosce meno il paese.

Scopriamo insieme notizie di attualità, sport, cinema, moda e musica di RAI Italia per gli Italiani all'estero e per quanti nel mondo amano l'Italia e la sua grande ricchezza culturale, paesaggistica e produttiva.
Due squadre composte da tre giocatori si sfidano in una serie di prove nelle quali devono mostrare le loro conoscenze e aggiudicarsi il montepremi accumulato risolvendo la reazione a catena finale.

p.t: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
p.d: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.
Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart.
Filmmaker Jessica Sanders interviews seven men who were wrongfully imprisoned until DNA testing set them free.
Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.
A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.
Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences.

Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.
After losing her teaching career, A transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children.
Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever.

The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

Point guards including Rafer Alston, Kenny Anderson, Mark Jackson, Stephon Marbury, Kenny Smith and Rod Strickland hone their craft and taste for showmanship on New York City's iconic playgrounds and in high school gyms in the 1980s and '90s.

Kenny and Giselle are set to marry on a beach in Puerto Rico. Giselle disappears on the day of the ceremony, setting off a wild chain of events that unearths secrets, lies and betrayal, and threatens to destroy the fairy-tale love story.

The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads; the loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.

The Jokers play lawyers trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in.

The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons.

Una apasionada historia donde el amor no respeta tradiciones y suele quebrar con los esquemas de la época, todo ello enmarcado en la salitrera chilena Pampa Ilusión.

Catalina Chamorro, una mujer de carácter fuerte, rechaza a cuantos pretendientes se crucen en su camino. El problema es que su padre se niega a entregar en matrimonio a Blanca, su hija menor, hasta que no haya casado a Catalina, la mayor.

W kazdym odcinku emitowanego codziennie programu w roli komentatorów wystepuja specjalisci z wybranych dziedzin, prezentowane sa wystepy muzyczne, a takze porady i segment kulinarny.
Polskie technologie podbijaja miedzynarodowe rynki innowacji, patentów i instytucji badawczych. Program przedstawia polskich wynalazców, których rozwiazania trafiaja do swiatowej rangi projektów.
Serwis informacyjny, nadawany co pól godziny, przedstawia najwazniejsze biezace wydarzenia.
Mieszkancy postanawiaja pozbyc sie Mirki i jej uciazliwego quadowiska. Pisza petycje od nadlesnictwa. Marysia romansuje z Krzysztofem. Niespodziewanie z Francji wraca Kuba, który przeprasza zone.

Konrad postanawia walczyc o szczescie. Do Pasymia wraz z nim przyjezdza Kuba, a ich los jest bardzo podobny. Obaj walcza o milosc, która na wlasne zyczenie, kazdy na swój sposób, stracili. Kuba ma trudniejsze zadanie niz Konrad - pojawia sie rywal.
Film dokumentalny przybliza prawdziwe historie zolnierzy podleglych generalowi Stanislawowi Maczkowi, tzw. maczków, którzy walczyli w wielu kluczowych bitach w czasie drugiej wojny swiatowej.

Cykl przybliza wspólczesna polszczyzne okiem mlodego pokolenia jezykoznawców. Jezyk polski dazy do skrótu, kondensacji mysli, nazwania nowych zjawisk, które w perspektywie Internetu staja sie codziennoscia mlodych ludzi.
Audycja przedstawia podstawowy serwis informacyjny Telewizji Polskiej. Program ma charakter informacyjny, a prezentowane materialy pochodza czesto z regionalnych oddzialów nadawcy publicznego.

Tomasz Bednarek odwiedza Wolinski Park Narodowy, który lezy w srodkowo-zachodniej czesci wyspy Wolin, a jego powierzchnia wynosi 10 937 ha. W programie nie brakuje spektakularnych zdjec lotniczych i animacji.

Program poswiecony jest kulturze jezyka polskiego. Profesorowi Janowi Miodkowi towarzyszy Justyna Janus-Konarska, dr nauk humanistycznych, jezykoznawca i medioznawca. Prowadzaca uczy obcokrajowców jezyka polskiego.

Marta Perchuc-Burzynska rozmawia z wybitnymi artystami o dziecinstwie, domu rodzinnym i najwazniejszych doswiadczeniach, które w istotny sposób wplynely na ich zycie i droge twórcza. Tym razem do swojego wnetrza zaprasza aktorka Ewa Kasprzyk.

Zaplakana Luiza zjawia sie niespodziewanie u Wójcików i wyznaje, ze zostala zdradzona przez Aro. Tymczasem Daniel odwozi do Pyrków Emila po jego calonocnej ucieczce, a nastepnie wdaje sie w szpitalu z Hubertem w ostry spór.

Codzienny magazyn przedstawia najswiezsze informacje z kraju i swiata w przystepnej formie. Obok najwazniejszych aktualnosci, w programie pojawiaja sie wiadomosci sportowe, muzyczne oraz stale cykle tematyczne.
Teleturniej oferuje widzom klasyczne lamiglówki w nowoczesnej formie. Program jest codziennym quizem wiedzy skoncentrowanym na ugruntowanym i nieslabnacym od lat fenomenie popularnosci krzyzówek.

Audycja rozwija najwazniejsze tematy zawarte w Teleexpressie oraz pokazuje nowe, krótkie reportaze. W polowie wydania prezentowana jest prognoza pogody dla miejscowosci o ciekawych i niecodziennych nazwach zwiazanych z poprzednim materialem.

Le village de Salvérac est menacé par un projet de forage de gaz de schiste ; le village est divisé entre ceux qui soutiennent ce projet et les autres, menés par la maire Floriane Bourdieu, qui s'y opposent fermement.
